description: Inflammatory dermatitis affecting skin under a diaper or nappy, most commonly due to irritant contact dermatitis.
causes: Secondary Candida or bacterial infection can complicate dermatitis

appearance.general: Erythematous macules and papules in the diaper area, with fold sparing in classic irritant dermatitis; Candida may produce satellite papules or pustules.

general_first_aid: Keep the diaper area clean and dry.
prevention: Reduce friction and prolonged contact with urine or stool.
doctor_discussion_points: Discuss whether the rash involves folds, satellite pustules, recurrent episodes, or signs of infection.
